payload.title: Correct Console score-workflow status summaries
payload.description:
As a Console user, I want score-workflow summaries to reflect the terminal evaluation state and the complete chat history, so that I do not receive contradictory or stale validation guidance.

Feature: Accurate score-workflow summaries

Scenario: Failed evaluation summary
  Given a chat contains evaluation evidence with a failed terminal status
  When the workflow summary is displayed
  Then the heading identifies the evaluation as failed
  And the guidance does not describe it as queued

Scenario: Validation exists in another chat message
  Given a score change is recorded in one chat message
  And completed or queued validation evidence exists in another message in the same chat
  When the workflow summary is displayed
  Then the chat does not claim that no validation run was found
  And the validation evidence is summarized once

Out of scope: changing score data, dispatching evaluations, or altering task state.
